aiComplete.modelDraft: Closing keeps the draft. Use the page's Save button to apply it.
aiComplete.modelHeadersHint: Sent only for this model. Matching names override provider headers; model-list requests do not use these headers.
aiComplete.claudeTUIHint: Interactive mode runs Claude Code in its own hidden terminal and reads its transcript. Upstream describes roughly half the five-hour allowance for the same work.
aiComplete.claudePrintHint: claude -p uses the print mode used by scripts and the Agent SDK, without first opening an interactive terminal. Upstream describes roughly twice the interactive mode’s allowance use.
aiComplete.claudeFallbackHint: With interactive mode enabled, unsupported requests or startup failures report why. A turn Anthropic refuses as a third-party app runs as -p under upstream rules. This choice shares Advanced settings and applies after Save.
aiComplete.claudeReason.os: This system cannot run interactive mode
aiComplete.claudeReason.missing: Claude Code was not found. Install the official client first
aiComplete.endpointsHint: Edit the primary endpoint above. Enter additional endpoints separately; empty means unavailable.
aiComplete.fetchListHint: When off, use only manually added models and never fetch the vendor list.
aiComplete.refreshEveryHint: Empty for manual refresh; for example 30m, 6h or 1d. Minimum 10 minutes.
aiComplete.autoIncludeHint: One model ID pattern per line. Use * or a regular expression prefixed with re:.
aiComplete.unlistedHint: Still available through routing groups or the full provider/model ID.
aiComplete.balanceServiceHint: Known vendors usually need no override. A custom endpoint uses the current key.
aiComplete.fallbackHint: One provider/model ID per line. Try in order when this provider fails before sending content.
aiComplete.nativeCompactionHint: Let the vendor Responses API compact the conversation.
aiComplete.pinUpstreamHint: Keep a conversation on the relay’s same upstream to preserve prompt caching.
aiComplete.restHint: The vendor retry time takes priority. 0 uses defaults; a rest cap of -1 disables rest for unexplained failures.
aiComplete.quotaResetAtHint: For example 08:00 (local time) or 00:00+08:00 (specified time zone).
aiComplete.balanceCurrencyHint: Changing currency keeps the entered number without conversion. Remaining balance is estimated from recorded usage.
aiComplete.serviceCredentialsHint: Fill only when required by your vendor. Leave unchanged to keep a saved value; clear and save to remove it.
aiComplete.modelRefreshFailure: The last automatic model refresh failed. Check the connection and retry.
aiComplete.providerEnabledHint: Turning this off keeps settings and keys, and stops requests and automatic maintenance.
aiComplete.modelAliasHint: Clients use provider/alias. The upstream model name below controls the name sent to the service.
aiComplete.contextRulesHint: Set context windows by model ID. * applies to all models; per-model settings take precedence.
aiComplete.accountRefreshHint: Account provider models refresh hourly. Temporarily unavailable selections are checked every 5 minutes.
aiComplete.gatewayListenHint: The service stops when WinOne exits. Only local connections are accepted by default.
aiComplete.gatewayLANHint: Listen on all IPv4 addresses. Calls still require the access key and enabled models.
aiComplete.gatewayIPsHint: One per line, such as 192.168.1.0/24. Empty allows authenticated clients; local connections remain available.
aiComplete.gatewayOriginsHint: One full origin per line, such as https://chat.example.com, without a path. Empty blocks cross-origin browser requests.
